UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public manager account metadata without PII.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the football manager.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record containing the user's verified Gmail address.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated.

CareerSave.title: CareerSave
CareerSave.description: Cloud career save slot storing native Firestore maps for world state deltas.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the save owner.

slotId.description: Save slot identifier (e.g. slot_autosave, slot_1, slot_2).

saveName.description: Human-readable name of the career save.

clubName.description: Name of the controlled football club.

managerName.description: Name of the manager in this career save.

lastSavedAtIso.description: Client ISO string for UI display.

controlledClubId.description: ID of the user's controlled club.

careerState.description: Native Firestore map containing mutable career state deltas.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the save slot was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the save slot was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores public manager profile metadata per authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores isolated PII (verified Gmail address) restricted strictly to the owner.

/users/{userId}/saves/{slotId}.description: Stores cloud football career save slots belonging to the user.
